about_the_game:
Ko ima ni ari is an interactive story-driven game about the past, present and future of someone loosing slowly their sight.

Venture into a simple and short visual novel driven by it's art, music and detail story.

The game feature only story text that you will follow in a linear or non linear way in order to understand the story overall.
